---
title: Skip-to-content link
toc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          # Not anchored to `body >`: the hub preview renders the link
          # inside React's `#root` (bd-21n09dwj). That it is the first
          # element of the rendered body is checked by the regex below.
          - 'a#quarto-skip-link.visually-hidden-focusable[href="#quarto-document-content"]'
          # target is focusable via the link
          - 'main#quarto-document-content[tabindex="-1"]'
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [">Skip to main content</a>", '<body[^>]*>\s*<a id="quarto-skip-link"']
        - []
---

HTML documents include a "Skip to main content" link as the first element
of the body so that keyboard users can bypass navigation blocks such as the
TOC (bd-rbd3jq4n; Quarto 1 #14684/#14685, WCAG 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks).
